correctness.rationale: The increment between coupled unreflected drivers is nonnegative and nondecreasing within each excursion; the increase of the running-supremum regulator is at most the current increment. This gives position order up to the first hit and, with simultaneous resets, time order. For strictness choose a short no-reset interval and Brownian tubes around deterministic paths such that neither upper wall is reached, the lower trajectory crosses zero, and the upper one stays positive. For the response, the killed generator acting on f_s+εvg_s minus s times this function has residual ε²v²g_s′ with unchanged terminal/reflection conditions, so stopped discounted Itô gives the derivative. At fixed τ and bounded initial v the weak-activity moment expansion can likewise be justified without formally differentiating a PDE: U=m_1+εva and W=m_2+εvb satisfy L_εU=−1+ε²v²a′ and L_εW=−2U+ε²v²b′. Stopping U and W+2tU+t² gives remainders bounded by ε² times killed integrals of (1+t)V_t². The passive killed survival decays exponentially; conditional Gaussian drift change and Cauchy–Schwarz give a uniform exponential bound for sufficiently small |ε|, because the OU covariance operator on [0,t] has bounded norm and trace O(t), so E exp(c ε²∫V²) grows only as exp(O(ε² t)) for compact initial states. Interior elliptic W^{2,p} estimates on compact position–velocity rectangles bound the spatial derivative of each moment remainder by O(ε²); this supplies the local unique zero and its shift. Renewal gives the displayed mean and transform formulas, and the two decaying exponents in g_s/f_s differ by q−k with k(q−k)→1/(2Dτ), giving −x/(2D). The short-persistence limit is the interior approximate-identity property R_τ/τ→I (the 2R_τa term is O(τ²)); the long-persistence integrals reproduce the positive coefficient.
residual_risks: Only local critical position and sequential limits; no uniqueness of the crossover, no global finite-activity boundary, and no assertion for velocity not reset.

Comparing them in one natural killed process clarifies why a uniform velocity order does not constrain the direction of shift of the local onset.
